messages:
nina: spotted a ClusterRoleBinding that grants cluster-admin to serviceaccount 'collector' in onprem-dc namespace. opening thread to triage.

omar: yikes. paste the binding and which pipeline ran it?

nina: audit extract:
```json
{
  "kind": "ClusterRoleBinding",
  "metadata": { "name": "collector-admin-override" },
  "subjects": [{ "kind": "ServiceAccount", "name": "collector", "namespace": "onprem-dc" }],
  "roleRef": { "kind": "ClusterRole", "name": "cluster-admin" }
}
```

lee: oncall here. immediate plan: revoke binding, create scoped Role, patch DaemonSet to use new SA, apply NetworkPolicy to lock egress to KMS endpoint only, rotate KMS key if used. tagging @ops-oncall to gate key ops.

ops-oncall: running commands now: delete binding, create Role 'collector-min' with secrets/get only, bind to 'collector-scoped'. patch DS to use new SA, apply NP to namespace, create new KMS key and restrict IAM to serviceaccount principal.

sec-bot: Alert: excessive-rbac detected in cluster onprem-dc at 1749991105. Suggested mitigation: revoke cluster-admin and rotate credentials.

omar: added a quick NetworkPolicy draft to deny all egress from pods labeled app=collector except to internal IP 10.10.0.5 and namespaceSelector infra=kms.

lee: NP applied and verified. pods cannot reach internet. ops-oncall: any KMS decrypts logged recently?

ops-oncall: SIEM shows two kms:Decrypt calls from pod IP 10.10.2.8 in last 12m. rotating key now and updating agent configmap. will revoke old key decrypt after re-encrypt.

nina: root cause appears to be an older deploy-helper template that allowed cluster-admin when team_override=true. follow-ups: bake Gatekeeper constraint to block ClusterRoleBinding creations, add pre-apply linter rule, and require two approvals for onprem cluster-admin changes.

omar: I'll open SECURITY-2039 for follow-ups and schedule a tabletop next week.

lee: done with immediate mitigations. monitoring for suspicious egress and failed decrypts. closing thread after confirmation window. :lock:
